summary: woman stranded on a log in Jasper Creek at the Hessie waterfalls holding her friend's dog Bjorne, which had slipped in, been swept downstream, and trapped against the log and a boulder; companion ran to the trailhead for cell service and called 911 ~12:45; technical rope evacuation set up shore-to-shore; woman and dog brought to shore uninjured, walked out
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District, Nederland Police Department, Boulder Emergency Squad, Longmont Emergency Unit, American Medical Response
notes: two women mushroom-picking; friend's dog off leash slipped into creek; Jessica crawled onto the log and pulled the dog out but could not get back across with the dog; names withheld at parties' request; story ID (2238-adjacent) and 'last Wednesday, July 15' pin the year to 2015 (Wednesday-verified)
